title: Dinner on Friday
text:
Hi Tom,

Are you free on Friday evening? It's my birthday on Friday and I would like to invite you to dinner at Bella Pizza. It's a small Italian restaurant in King Street, opposite the cinema. The table is for seven o'clock.

The pizza there is very good and it isn't expensive. Anna and Jack can come, but Sam can't because he works on Fridays.

Please send me a message before Thursday.

See you,
Lucy

exercises.prompt: The restaurant is next to the cinema.
exercises.explanation: Restauracja jest naprzeciwko kina: „opposite the cinema”.

exercises.prompt: Sam can come to the dinner.
exercises.explanation: „...Sam can't because he works on Fridays.”
Tekst nie mówi, czy Tom lubi pizzę.
„a small Italian restaurant... it isn't expensive.”

exercises.prompt: Please send me a ___ before Thursday.
Połącz słowa z tekstu z tłumaczeniem.
